snippet.title: Cloud Path (Ketchapp)
snippet.description:
iOS : https://itunes.apple.com/app/cloud-path/id990628529

Android : https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ketchapp.cloudpath

Walk on the path as fast as you can, and earn one point for each step you do. Collect gems and unlock new characters!

◉ Tap right to walk.
◉ Tap left to jump the stairs.

Be careful and make the right move!

What is your best score?
